name: channel

identity_description: User-confirmed native abilityId identifies each payment channel configuration.

fields.name: abilityId
fields.meaning: Native configuration primary key, preserved without conversion.

limitations: WIP: production full-source coverage remains unqualified. Sample cross-page duplicate IDs do not prove complete acquisition; this package is not a delivered leaf.
POST ifundboss-api.alipay.com/payout/api/ability/search.json; one-based pageNum and fixed pageSize 100. No unqualified cross-width repair or short-page termination.

Acquire the complete chosen payout scope, then apply all eight exact local filters in live and offline views. Business filters never alter source acquisition. Native totals remain separate from matched_total.
Native abilityId is the primary key. Identical repeated IDs retain one native record and incomplete coverage; conflicting contents for the same ID fail the whole command.
Custom execution only enforces the approved hard conflict failure on host-collected evidence. The general SDK owns pagination, budgets, identity and total coverage.
All native fields, configVersion, nested values, types and response order remain unchanged. No synthetic ID, timestamp winner or fee computation.
Live does not publish; incomplete, conflicting, failed or empty refresh preserves the previous capture. No Get or new Duckdog import.

examples.title: Filter the saved source
examples.command: dogopencli payment list channel --financial-inst-id BANK --status ENABLE --limit 0
